# Timing budget (generated by analysis/monitoring/sync/budgets.py)

Latency is a fixed delay that calibration removes; uncertainty is what is left (or the jitter). Position = uncertainty x speed.

| path | element | latency (µs) | uncertainty (µs) | at 0.4 m/s (µm) | at 1.1 m/s (µm) | basis | source |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| beam position | RTC6 output grid (the master clock) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | reference; outputs change only on 10 µs ticks | rtc6 |
| beam position | commanded -> actual spot (tracking delay), before calibration | 250 | 25 | 10 | 27.5 | ±10 % assumed | basicube |
| beam position | commanded -> actual spot, after the knife-edge test (§1.5) | 250 | 3 | 1.2 | 3.3 | assumed reach of the test | basicube |
| laser | LASERON edge after mark start (LaserOnDelay) | 0 | 0.016 | 0.01 | 0.02 | set in 1/64 µs steps; deterministic | rtccmp |
| laser | gate -> light (IPG YLR-U3) | 12 | 1 | 0.4 | 1.1 | <= 12 µs published; jitter assumed | ipg |
| photodiode | PDA36A2 at 30 dB (260 kHz): group delay | 0.612 | 0.1 | 0.04 | 0.11 | first-order filter | pda |
| photodiode | 2.5 m RG-58 | 0.013 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 5.1 ns/m (velocity factor 0.66) | ours |
| digitizer | gate tap 10 kΩ into 17.5 pF: 50 % point of the RC step | 0.121 | 0.02 | 0.01 | 0.02 | RC ln 2, calibrated out | pico |
| digitizer | PicoScope at 2 MS/s: sample quantisation | 0 | 0.144 | 0.06 | 0.16 | uniform over 0.5 µs | pico |
| digitizer | clock vs RTC6, no fit, 30 s layer | 0 | 3000 | 1200 | 3300 | ±50 ppm each side (RTC6 assumed) | pico |
| digitizer | clock vs RTC6, per-layer fit to gate edges | 0 | 0.5 | 0.2 | 0.55 | bound; synthetic check gives less (reader_check.md) | pico |
| AE | elastic path, plate and stack (10-25 mm at 5-6 km/s) | 3 | 2 | 0.8 | 2.2 | assumed | ours |
| AE | elastic path, 150-250 mm waveguide | 39 | 10 | 4 | 11 | 15 µs per 76.5 mm | zel |
| AE | preamp and 50-600 kHz filter | 2 | 1 | 0.4 | 1.1 | assumed | ours |
| coaxial camera | trigger generator (RP2350 PIO, 150 MHz) | 0.05 | 0.007 | 0 | 0.01 | one clock cycle; assumed | ours |
| coaxial camera | XTR edge -> exposure start (IMX296) | 15 | 15 | 6 | 16.5 | not published: assumed <= one line; measure (§1.5) | gs |
| coaxial camera | frame time label = mid-exposure (50 µs exposure) | 25 | 0 | 0 | 0 | by definition | gs |
| side camera | Chronos exposure trigger on TRIG1 (BNC) | 0 | 0.5 | 0.2 | 0.55 | within 500 ns | kron |
| layer camera | software still after spread / after lasing | 100000 | 50000 | 20000 | 55000 | assumed; the scene is static | ours |
| slow channels | PLC -> Modbus TCP -> Pi timestamp | 20000 | 10000 | 4000 | 11000 | assumed; module filtering not included | ours |
| Pi clock | RTC6 layer-start bit on a Pi GPIO (kernel edge timestamp) | 50 | 50 | 20 | 55 | assumed | ours |

## Mapping a photodiode sample to (x, y)

| correction applied | timing error (µs) | at 0.4 m/s (µm) | at 1.1 m/s (µm) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| no clock fit, no tracking delay (DAQ started on a trigger, nominal rate; worst point of a 30 s layer) | 3010.4 | 1204.2 | 3311.4 |
| clock fit, tracking delay ignored | 250 | 100 | 275 |
| clock fit + tracking delay from the data sheet (±25 µs) | 25.01 | 10 | 27.5 |
| clock fit + tracking delay calibrated (±3 µs) | 3.05 | 1.2 | 3.4 |

## Static galvo errors (need the spot-grid calibration, not timing)

| item | µm |
|---|---:|
| offset drift per K (30 µrad/K) | 4.8 |
| gain drift per K at r = 37.9 mm (160 ppm/K) | 6.1 |
| 8 h offset drift (100 µrad) | 16 |
| 8 h gain drift at r = 37.9 mm (250 ppm) | 9.5 |
| repeatability (2 µrad RMS) | 0.32 |

## Sources

- **rtc6**: SCANLAB RTC6 brochure (SCANLAB-RTC6-EN.pdf, 11/2026): 10 µs output period, laser signals at 15 ns resolution
- **rtccmp**: SCANLAB RTC comparison table (SCANLAB-RTC-Comparison-EN.pdf): laser delays in 1/64 µs; 2 x 2^24 or 4 x 2^23 recorded values
- **basicube**: SCANLAB basiCube 20 page (read 2026-11-25): tracking error 0.25 ms; step 0.58 ms (10 mrad); drift offset < 30 µrad/K, gain < 160 ppm/K; 8 h offset < 100 µrad, gain < 250 ppm; repeatability < 2 µrad RMS
- **ipg**: electrical.md §11, from IPG's YLR-U3 sheet: on/off <= 12 µs, modulation <= 100 kHz
- **pda**: Thorlabs PDA36A user guide table (via search): 260 kHz at 30 dB, 150 kHz at 40 dB, 45 kHz at 50 dB; the PDA36A2's own sheet not read
- **pico**: PicoScope 4444 datasheet: 14-bit at 50 MS/s, streaming 10 MS/s (PicoScope 6) or 50 MS/s (SDK), timebase ±50 ppm, all channels sampled together, 3 ps RMS sample jitter, 1 MΩ || 17.5 pF per input
- **gs**: Raspberry Pi documentation, Global Shutter Camera, external trigger: XTR is a 1.8 V input; exposure = low pulse + 14.26 µs; frame rate = pulse rate
- **kron**: Kron Technologies, 'Triggering & Synchronizing Multiple Chronos Cameras' rev 0.1.0: with an external source, footage synchronised within 500 ns
- **zel**: Zelenyak et al. 2015 (Sensors 15:11805), via edison/r8-ae-waveguide: each extra 76.5 mm of waveguide added ~15 µs
- **nist**: Lane & Yeung 2020 (J. Res. NIST 125:125027): 100 kHz XYPT commands, 10 kHz coaxial camera, 20 µs exposure
- **heat**: heat.md: 0.2 s of jumps per layer, 8 s recoat; dense L75 build +51 % time with the dwell (electrical.md §9.1)
- **mon**: monitoring.md §5.3 and analysis/out/monitoring/optics.md (stream rates)
- **ours**: assumed in this note (sync-and-data.md); to measure
